title: nan
authors: Bachrach A.; Prentice S.; He R.; Roy N.
key_contribution: Presents a multi-level sensing and control hierarchy combining laser scan-matching, state estimation filter, and SLAM for autonomous quadrotor navigation in unknown GPS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
